integrity: Exact proofs and a standalone finite checker are included. The checker corroborates finite instances but does not replace the all-length argument.
scientific_limitations: Extremizers are exhibited but not fully classified. First-appearance spectrum concerns distinct scattered output words of one cyclic-order infinite word, not arbitrary-source embedding multiplicities. Novelty remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Sharp minimum and first-appearance spectrum of letter-duplicated subsequences
